content: In a note MK says Qāsim-i Anvār (d. 837/1434), apart from being Niʿmat Allāh Valī's khalīfa and a dāʿī for the Ṣafaviyya, was one of Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's companions in Cairo, citing the Niʿmatullahi Savāniḥ passage.
refers_to_primary: Mufīd Mustawfī, Jāmiʿ-i Mufīdī 3/16-17; Aubin, Majmūʿa, 156-57 (via MK fn 45)
